description: Screens a US-listed company against four published Shariah equity standards (AAOIFI, Dow Jones Islamic Market, S&P Shariah, MSCI Islamic), first on its business (prohibited industries each standard excludes) and then on its debt, using live market data and the company's own SEC filings. Also screens a whole portfolio, finds halal alternatives, calculates dividend purification and zakat. Every answer carries a 'say' field: one or two plain sentences to read aloud. Research output, not investment advice. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://askmizan.com
